text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae began her preparations for 
the Champions Cup. Lately, though—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—It's time for "Local Idol Search Party!" 
We've got all sorts of local idols 
gathered here this week too~!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
First up is... the local idol from 
Tomakomai, Hokkaido! Hokko Tarumae! Give 
us a greeting!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hello there~♪ Flying in from Tomakomai 
Port, it's the migratory bird on paper 
wings! Hokki clam lover☆ Tomakomai's local 
idol, Hokko Tarumae♪

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae-san serves as a Tomakomai 
Tourism Ambassador as a local idol, but 
she's actually a student at that famous 
Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
She's an active competitor in the Twinkle 
Series, still running in races today~!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's amazing! A legit athlete! 
We're starting off with some heavy hitters 
today~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll be running in the GⅠ race held this 
December, the Champions Cup! I'd be so 
happy if you cheered for me!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"You're running in a GⅠ!? That's crazy 
amazing! Why are you working as a local 
idol, then!?"

text_block_list.name: Underground Idol
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Thanks for coming to our 
Hana☆Ayame concert today~!

text_block_list.name: Underground Idol
text_block_list.text:
"And now, it's time for our announced 
guest of the day! It's local idol Hokko 
Tarumae-chan~!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hello there~! Flying in from Tomakomai 
Port, it's the migratory bird on paper 
wings! Hokki clam lover☆ Tomakomai's local 
idol, Hokko Tarumae♪

text_block_list.name: Underground Idol
text_block_list.text:
Some of you might already know this, but 
Tarumae-chan is a horse girl who runs in 
the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Underground Idol
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, you're running in 
a big race at the end of the year, right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm running in a GⅠ race called the 
Champions Cup this December! Root for me 
if you'd like☆

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—When I heard Ms. Hana Ayame was from 
Hokkaido, I felt an instant connection! 
I'm so happy to get to sing with you 
today, don'tcha know!

text_block_list.name: Underground Idol
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! Let's get hyped! Fans, y'all can 
still turn it up even more, right?! Let's 
gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Phew... We can finally take a breather.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since the summer training camp, 
Hokko Tarumae had been actively pursuing 
various local idol activities in between 
her rigorous training sessions.
choice_data_list: Thanks for all your hard work again today.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work today as 
well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry for making dinner so late and 
dragging you along with me.
choice_data_list:
Let's call this our little celebration for 
all your hard work today!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That sounds lovely. 'Today's Great 
Job Party'.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Somehow, that puts me at ease.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks in part to her hard work, Hokko 
Tarumae's popularity as a local idol is 
rising even faster than ever before."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This in itself was a very good thing, but—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—As usual, compared to entertainment 
content, the growth on informational posts 
is rather modest...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The content showcasing Tomakomai—the most 
important thing to Hokko Tarumae—hadn't 
taken the positive turn she had hoped 
for...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...We have to accept reality.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Right now, everyone is paying attention to 
"me" merely as a local idol, and—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Not everyone who takes an interest 
actually ends up visiting Tomakomai."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't mean the effect is zero," 
right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. I believe I understand that 
part well enough.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Shall we head out? We've finished 
eating, and I don't think this is the kind 
of talk we should have here."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Just as you said, Trainer, since the 
overall fan base is growing, the total 
number of people visiting should be 
increasing as well.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
However... if things continue at this 
current rate, my value as a local idol 
will hit its ceiling, and once I can't 
grow any further—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The actual figures leading to visits to 
Tomakomai stop at just 'a slight 
increase.'

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to be satisfied with just 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of everyone who supported 
and helped me so much leading up to 
today—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Allllriiiight!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Reality acceptance time is over! Time to 
switch gears, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There are still things I can do! As a 
local idol and as a dirt Umamusume, I can 
take on more challenges! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"If we deliver results at the Champions 
Cup and promote Tomakomai on a massive 
scale there, things are sure to take a 
turn for the better!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment I was about to give a firm, 
resounding affirmation to Hokko Tarumae's 
question—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—Take good care of Tarumae-chan, okay? 
Watch over her even closer and more often 
than I do!”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If Tarumae-chan keeps aiming for the 
"center" like this—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Because one day... you'll have to face 
something."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting on Smart Falcon's words, I 
spoke with determination, rather than 
offering fleeting words of comfort like 
before.
choice_data_list:
I'm sure you can turn things around in the 
Champions Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if it can't be changed, I'll just 
stay by her side and blaze a trail so that 
it can."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Hokko Tarumae's Trainer, with all my 
might—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Your words are always so warm, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Once we get back to the academy, could 
I consult with you about my self-training 
routine? I want to make better use of my 
time—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For the Champions Cup, let's just keep 
putting in honest effort and pressing 
forward." Making that promise to each 
other, we head on our way home—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —At the same time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Phewwww... haaaah...—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I can't very well run in a 
half-hearted state, after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm the 'Storyteller'— I will 
stand before Tarumae-chan in Falco-san's 
place."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...If you don't become a demon about it, 
you won't make it, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At the forefront of the dirt tracks, the 
stars were about to clash their brilliant 
radiance—"
